product_metadata.title: Mind Reader Alloy Collection, 3-Tier Industrial Microwave Stand with Utility Shelf and Drying Hooks, Metal, Silver
features: Sleek and Modern Design: The chrome plated metal construction of this 3-tier stand and shelf offers a minimalistic and modern look that seamlessly blends into your kitchen or butler's pantry. Its clean lines and sleek finish add a touch of elegance to your space while keeping it organized

Maximize Counter Space: With three tiers of storage, this stand allows you to vertically organize your small kitchen appliances, plates, baking items, and more. By utilizing vertical space, you can free up valuable counter space and keep your kitchen tidy and clutter-free

Sturdy and Reliable: The wire mesh shelves of this stand are designed to hold up to 30 lbs (13.6 kg) each, providing a strong and stable platform for your items. You can trust that your appliances and other items will be securely supported

Durable and Easy to Clean: Built for daily use, this stand is made from durable materials that can withstand the demands of a busy kitchen. Cleaning is a breeze - simply wipe it down with a soft cloth and mild soap to keep it looking pristine

Optimal Dimensions: This 3-tier microwave stand measures 21.25 inches (54 cm) long by 13.5 inches (34.3 cm) wide by 49.5 inches (126 cm) tall. Its compact size allows it to fit seamlessly into your kitchen without taking up excessive space, while still providing ample storage capacity
description: Efficient Space Management with the Three-Tier Utility Shelf  Efficiency and style come together with this three-tier industrial-looking metal shelf. Designed to provide a practical solution for your storage needs, this shelf features drying hooks and a utility shelf, creating an organized kitchen space at your fingertips.  The shelf system comes with four hooks, perfect for drying hand towels or hanging pots, pans, and utensils. The top-most shelf creates an ideal place for storing spices and condiments, keeping them within easy reach. The middle shelf, with its secondary tabletop, conveniently holds a microwave or other small kitchen appliances. The bottom two shelves offer ample storage for pots, pans, baking trays, and more.  Cleaning this microwave stand and utility shelf is a breeze. Simply wipe it down with mild soap and a soft towel to keep it looking new. Constructed with durability in mind, this microwave stand can withstand daily use. Its four feet are equipped with rubber grips, ensuring stability and preventing movement. For flexibility, you can remove the bottom two wire shelves to accommodate larger appliances.  Once fully assembled, the stand measures 49.5 inches tall, 21.25 inches long, and 13.5 inches deep. The 4-hook right-arm can be attached for additional space but can also be omitted in tighter spaces.  The stand, part of the versatile Alloy Collection, makes an excellent gift for first-time renters, new homeowners, or anyone who appreciates a tidy kitchen space. Experience the convenience of organized living with this three-tier utility shelf.
